王铁柱，李伟和刘大山三人摆上小桌子等着喝酒，赵爷爷也想喝可是他的身体不允许呀。一院子的孩子都围在锅沿儿边眼巴巴的看着，王野都看见了这些孩子不停的蠕动喉咙。

王野从兜里拿出一把水果糖，一人给了一块儿说：“别急啊，一会儿就熟了。”接着就是七嘴八舌的谢谢哥哥。

时间在等待中总是很漫长的，王野在不知道说了多少次快熟了后终于出锅了。孩子们很自觉的排好队，从小到大整整齐齐。就连王江河也在队伍里。

现在整个院子的孩子只有两个不在队伍中，一个是刘家的小儿子刘援朝，和王野的宝贝妹妹王笑笑。刘援朝才六个多月，想吃肉条件也不允许。而王笑笑就不一样了，她是绝对的特权阶级。

就王野那宠妹妹的样子，要是不先给小丫头留出来，剩下的额也不用吃了。王野从锅里捞出两大块儿骨头放在碗里就抱着王笑笑去一边了。

秦婉接过勺子先给大人盛来一盆，这一盆不光是骨头，还有半盆汤。接下来才开始给孩子们捞骨头。

所有的孩子都在拿到骨头后，开心的说一句谢谢王大娘。这群孩子从小到大“一”字蹲在墙根处，抱着骨头就在那里啃着。

不论最大的刘龙，还是最小的刘豹都啃的非常仔细，生怕留下一点肉。王野可不会让这么可爱的妹妹抱着骨头啃，而是拿出匕首幽影，一点一点的给她割下肉喂给她。

王野坐在台阶上，小丫头就瘫在王野怀里。王野割好的肉送到嘴边，小丫头才张嘴。李婶看着这对兄妹对秦婉说：“嫂子，你家小丫头天天这样吗？”

秦婉没好气的说：“可不是咋滴，这一天天的越来越没个丫头样了。小野这个臭小子说了他不知道多少遍了，就是不听。”

刘婶笑呵呵的说：“这不挺好的吗，人家大哥宠着妹妹有什么可说的呀。”

秦婉佯装生气的说：“宠着也要有个限度，你们看看这小丫头片子还有个姑娘样吗？我前些天说了句小野，你就惯着吧，看以后小丫头找了婆家被婆家管教你怎么办。这臭小子说，以后谁敢欺负他妹妹腿给人家打折。我都担心以后这小丫头无法无天。”

李婶说：“嫂子，你就别担心了，咱们小野这么懂事儿，笑笑跟着他长大了也会是个懂事儿的好姑娘。”

秦婉笑呵呵的说;“孩子大了，不好管了，现在有时候我和他爹还得听他的呢。”

这波无形的炫耀可是让秦婉装到了。刘婶叹了口气说：“嫂子，你就偷着乐吧，你看看我家大龙，比小野就小一岁，一天天还不着四六，我都发愁。”

秦婉笑呵呵的说：“妹子，你也不用发愁，我家小野也是突然就好像长大了一样，你家大龙也会有这一天的。”

这也就是王野没听见，听见了肯定会说：“会长大也不会像我一样，要是真一样了我肯定得问问他微信号啥的。”

一院子的人吃的欢天喜地，王野每一块割完的骨头都递给王江河。这小子每次都高高兴兴的接过去。王野觉得小丫头已经吃的不少了，就不再喂他。

拿出一个大山楂丸偷偷的塞进小丫头的嘴里。其他人没有注意，可是一直关注着王野一举一动的王江河可看见了，王江河怯生生的问：“大哥，你给小妹吃的什么呀？”

王野说：“啃你的骨头去，见别人嘴动就着急，跟你有什么关系呀。”

王野给小丫头吃大山楂丸是因为王笑笑还小，吃这么多肉会消化不良。就算秦婉知道了也不会说什么，可是王江河都是个半大小子了，这要是让秦婉知道王野给他吃山楂丸助消化少不了又是一顿唠叨。

在现在的人眼里，吃饱了就应该去躺着待着。这样才不会浪费粮食，也不看看现在街面上哪儿还有卖糖葫芦的。肚子里本就没什么油水儿，还助消化这是真不知道四十二号的大鞋底子打人有多疼。

吃完饭王江河，李家大儿子李卫国，刘家老二刘虎，老三刘豹一人拿着一个陀螺跑到街上玩去了。刘家老大刘龙也想要被刘大山打了一巴掌说：“你见人家王野玩了吗，一天天的就知道玩儿。”

王野对着喝酒的李伟和老刘大山说：“李叔，刘叔动作挺快呀。昨天刚看见今天就给他们做出来了。”

李伟没好气的说：“还不是你个臭小子，我和你刘叔昨天晚上连夜做的。”

Wang Tiezhu, Li Wei and Liu Dashan set up a small table and waited to drink. Grandpa Zhao also wanted to drink but his body did not allow it.All the children in the yard gathered around the edge of the pot and watched eagerly. Wang Ye even saw the children's throats squirming incessantly.

Wang Ye took out a handful of fruit candies from his pocket, gave each of them a piece, and said, "Don't worry, it will be ready in a moment." Then everyone thanked his brother.

The waiting time is always very long. After Wang Ye said he didn’t know how many times it was almost done, he finally made it.The children lined up very consciously, neatly from small to large.Even Wang Jianghe was in the team.

Now there are only two children in the whole yard who are not in the team. One is Liu Yuanchao, the youngest son of the Liu family, and Wang Xiaoxiao, Wang Ye's baby sister.Liu Yuanchao was only more than six months old, and the conditions did not allow him to eat meat.But Wang Xiaoxiao is different, she is an absolute privileged class.

With the way Wang Ye doted on his sister, if he didn't set it aside for the little girl first, he wouldn't have to eat the rest.Wang Ye took out two large pieces of bones from the pot, put them in a bowl, and carried Wang Xiaoxiao away.

Qin Wan took the spoon and first filled a basin for the adults. This basin was not only filled with bones, but also half a basin of soup.Then we started to get bones for the children.

After getting the bones, all the children happily said thank you to Aunt Wang.This group of children have been squatting at the base of the wall since they were little, holding bones and gnawing there.

Both the eldest Liu Long and the youngest Liu Bao gnawed very carefully, for fear of leaving any meat behind.Wang Ye would not let such a cute sister hold the bones and chew them. Instead, he took out the dagger Shadow and cut off the meat bit by bit and fed it to her.

Wang Ye sat on the steps, and the little girl collapsed in Wang Ye's arms.Wang Ye's cut meat was brought to her mouth, and the little girl opened her mouth.Aunt Li looked at the brother and sister and said to Qin Wan, "Sister-in-law, is your little girl like this every day?"

Qin Wan said angrily: "It's not that bad. She's becoming less and less like a girl every day. This brat Xiaoye has said it to me countless times, but he just doesn't listen."

Aunt Liu said with a smile: "Isn't this good? What's there to say about the eldest brother pampering his younger sister?"

Qin Wan pretended to be angry and said: "There must be a limit to pampering. Do you think this little girl still looks like a girl in the movie? I said Xiaoye a few days ago, just let it go. We will see what you will do if the little girl goes to her husband's family and is disciplined by her husband's family. This brat said, who dares to bully his sister's legs and give them discounts in the future? I am worried that this little girl will be lawless in the future."

Aunt Li said: "Sister-in-law, don't worry, our Xiaoye is so sensible, Xiaoxiao will become a sensible and good girl when she grows up with him."

Qin Wan said with a smile, "It's hard to manage the child now that he's grown up. Now sometimes his father and I have to listen to him."

This invisible show off made Qin Wan pretend.Aunt Liu sighed and said, "Sister-in-law, just have fun secretly. Look at my Dalong. He is one year younger than Xiaoye. He is not four or six every day, and I am worried."

Qin Wan said with a smile: "Sister, you don't have to worry, my Xiaoye suddenly seems to have grown up, and your Dalong will also have this day."

This means that Wang Ye didn't hear it. If he heard it, he would definitely say: "When he grows up, he won't be like me. If he is really the same, I will definitely ask him about his WeChat ID or something."

The people in the yard ate happily, and Wang Ye handed every cut bone to Wang Jianghe.This kid happily took it every time.Wang Ye felt that the little girl had eaten a lot, so he stopped feeding him.

He took out a big hawthorn pill and secretly stuffed it into the little girl's mouth.Others didn't pay attention, but Wang Jianghe, who had been paying attention to Wang Ye's every move, saw it. Wang Jianghe asked timidly: "Brother, what did you give the little sister to eat?"

Wang Ye said: "Chew your bones and get anxious when you see other people moving their mouths. What does it have to do with you?"

Wang Ye gave the little girl hawthorn pills because Wang Xiaoxiao was still young and would suffer from indigestion after eating so much meat.Even if Qin Wan knew about it, he wouldn't say anything, but Wang Jianghe is already a young man. If Qin Wan knew that Wang Ye gave him hawthorn pills to help digestion, it would be another nagging.

In the eyes of today's people, when you are full, you should lie down and stay.This way we won’t waste food, and we won’t see where there are still candied haws sellers on the street.There is no oil or water in the stomach, and it also helps digestion. I really don’t know how painful it is to hit someone with the sole of a size 42 shoe.

After dinner, Wang Jianghe, the eldest son of the Li family, Li Weiguo, the second eldest son of the Liu family, Liu Hu, and the third eldest son of the Liu family, Liu Bao, ran to the street to play with a top.Liu Long, the eldest son of the Liu family, also wanted to be slapped by Liu Dashan and said, "Have you seen Wang Ye play? He knows how to play every day."

Wang Ye said to Li Wei and Old Liu Dashan who were drinking: "Uncle Li, Uncle Liu is very fast. I just saw it yesterday and made it for them today."

Li Wei said angrily: "You are not a brat, your Uncle Liu and I did it all night last night."
